headline_seed: Former Chick-fil-A employee charged in $80,000 mac-and-cheese scheme
description_seed: The Texas man allegedly refunded the orders of hundreds of catering-sized mac-and-cheese trays to his personal credit cards.

what: Former Chick-fil-A employee charged in $80,000 mac-and-cheese scheme

clean_source_blocks.text: The Texas man allegedly refunded the orders of hundreds of catering-sized mac-and-cheese trays to his personal credit cards.
Texas police have charged a former Chick-fil-A employee for allegedly defrauding the fast food company of the cost of 800 trays of mac-and-cheese.
A former Chick-fil-A employee was arrested for stealing $80,000 with a mac & cheese scheme at a Texas restaurant, police say.
They say he then refunded the cost of the order – $80,000 (£58,800) – to his personal credit cards.
